Operating Context: We review and refresh our focus
accordingly
• Our strategy represents our proactive and effective approach
to the operating environment
• We review and refresh our strategic responses regularly to
anticipate and manage risks while creating opportunities to
create value during times of structural changes in the industry

Governance, Risk Management, Performance Management:
How we govern and measure our progress
• Our governance approach promotes strategic decisions to
reconcile the interests of the bank and the society
• Our strategy is achieved within our risk appetite parameters to
ensure effective execution to yield results

Business Areas: How we share accountability to drive results
• Our business units and corporate functions have aligned
their execution priorities to our corporate strategy, towards
generating value to our stakeholders
